raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#45987 lets the output rank encode image bytes even with `save_output=False`. The GLM-Image distributed denoiser only disabled file saving, so it now clears the decoded tensor before sending a tensor-only result to the head. Generation succeeds, but the API returns 500 with `Model generation returned no output`.

This surfaced in [the NPU job on #45919](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39970902229/job/120473996801). It also reproduces on main without the progress-reporting changes.

## Modifications

- Keep decoded pixels as tensors on the GLM worker-to-head hop, matching the existing generic decoder path. The head still handles image encoding and persistence.
- Add regression coverage using real output materialization, ZMQ transport, and head-side encoding. Only model computation is stubbed. Cover one/two outputs, batched/sequential execution, and persistent/in-memory responses.

Production change: two added lines, including the ownership comment. No change to the ordinary image-bytes optimization, model computation, GT, or thresholds.

## Validation

- 8 regression cases fail on main with the missing output payload and pass with the fix.
- 162 related tests and 6 subtests pass; pre-commit passes.
- Real GLM-Image on 2 H200s: external SRT AR server, separate DiT/VAE worker, and HTTP head; 1024x1024, 30 denoising steps. Main reproduces the 500. With the fix, 12 requests return all 16 images across persistent and memory-only modes, including four concurrent requests mixing `n=1/2`.
- Invalid requests return 422; subsequent generation and health checks succeed. Workers create no image files. In persistent mode, all 8 saved images match the returned encoded bytes.

No kernel or model-forward changes, and no speedup claim. Ascend execution is left to CI; the real-model validation above is CUDA, not an NPU benchmark.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("sequential", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("output_count", [1, 2])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("persistent", [False, True])
+def test_disagg_returns_pixels_for_head_encoding(
+    monkeypatch, tmp_path, sequential, output_count, persistent
+):
+    req = _image_req(tmp_path, save_output=persistent, return_image_bytes=True)
+    req.num_outputs_per_prompt = output_count
+    req.prior_token_id = torch.arange(output_count).reshape(-1, 1)
+    head_req = copy.deepcopy(req)
+    pixels = torch.rand(output_count, 3, 8, 8)
+    worker = object.__new__(GPUWorker)
+    worker.is_output_rank = True
+
+    def compute(reqs):
+        (request,) = reqs
+        output = OutputBatch(output=pixels[request.prior_token_id.flatten()])
+        worker._materialize_output_transport(
+            output, request, lambda batch: worker._save_output_paths(request, batch)
+        )
+        return output
+
+    # Stub only the model computation, not materialization or the wire format.
+    monkeypatch.setattr(worker, "execute_forward", compute)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        worker,
+        "execute_forward_sequentially",
+        lambda reqs: (compute([r]) for r in reqs),
+    )
+    scheduler = object.__new__(Scheduler)
+    scheduler.worker = worker
+    scheduler._disagg_metrics = None
+    scheduler.server_args = SimpleNamespace(
+        pipeline_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            supports_sequential_multi_output_inference=lambda: sequential
+        )
+    )
+    with zmq.Context() as context:
+        with context.socket(zmq.PAIR) as sender, context.socket(zmq.PAIR) as receiver:
+            sender.bind("inproc://image-result")
+            receiver.connect("inproc://image-result")
+            receiver.setsockopt(zmq.RCVTIMEO, 1000)
+            scheduler._pool_result_push = sender
+            scheduler._execute_glm_distributed_denoiser_request(req, "image-request")
+            tensors, scalars = unpack_tensors(receiver.recv_multipart(), device="cpu")
+
+    assert scalars["request_id"] == "image-request"
+    assert "error" not in scalars
+    torch.testing.assert_close(tensors["output"], pixels, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        openai_utils,
+        "get_global_server_args",
+        lambda: SimpleNamespace(batching_max_size=1),
+    )
+    client = SimpleNamespace(forward=AsyncMock(return_value=OutputBatch(**tensors)))
+    paths, result = asyncio.run(openai_utils.process_generation_batch(client, head_req))
+    assert len(paths) == len(result.output_image_bytes) == output_count
+    for path, data, output in zip(
+        paths, result.output_image_bytes, pixels, strict=True
+    ):
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(_decode(data), _uint8_hwc(output))
+        assert os.path.exists(path) == persistent
+        if persistent:
+            with open(path, "rb") as file:
+                assert file.read() == data
